<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def sig(frame, r0, c0):
    ls = frame.ascii.split('\n')
    return tuple(''.join('1' if ls[r][c]=='B' else '0' for c in range(c0,c0+5)) for r in range(r0,r0+5))
c=15
start=sig(current_frame,52,c)
seq=[start]
for k in range(1,25):
    action(['UP'])
    s=sig(current_frame,52,c)
    seq.append(s)
    if s==start:
        print("cycle length:",k); break
else:
    print("no return in 24")
# dedupe order
seen=[]
for s in seq:
    if s not in seen: seen.append(s)
print("distinct:",len(seen))
targets={'3':('01110','00010','11111','00010','01110'),'r':('00001','00101','11111','10100','10000'),
'K':('11111','00101','00001','00101','11111'),'X':('11011','01010','01110','01010','11011'),
'T':('00100','00100','01110','00100','11111'),'B':('11111','10001','10111','10101','11111')}
for n,t in targets.items():
    print(n, "in palette:", t in seen, "idx:", seen.index(t) if t in seen else None)
print("start idx 0:", seen[0]==start)
# print palette compactly
for i,s in enumerate(seen): print(i, s)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
